# Tripadvisor
> Tripadvisor helps travelers discover, compare, and book hotels, restaurants, attractions, flights, cruises, and vacation rentals worldwide.

Tripadvisor combines traveler reviews, rankings, booking tools, and trip-planning resources across destinations, lodging, dining, experiences, and transportation.

## Core Travel Planning
- [Hotels](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotels): Browse hotels worldwide with traveler reviews, photos, prices, and availability.
- [Restaurants](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurants): Discover restaurants by destination, cuisine, rating, and traveler feedback.
- [Things to Do](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attractions): Explore attractions, tours, activities, and local experiences around the world.
- [Flights](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Flights): Compare flight options, fares, routes, and travel dates.
- [Vacation Rentals](https://www.tripadvisor.com/VacationRentals): Find vacation homes, apartments, villas, and other rental stays.
- [Cruises](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Cruises): Research cruise lines, ships, itineraries, and traveler cruise reviews.

## Trip Planning Tools
- [Travelers' Choice](https://www.tripadvisor.com/TravelersChoice): View award-winning hotels, restaurants, beaches, and destinations.
- [Forums](https://www.tripadvisor.com/ShowForum-g1-i1-General_Discussion.html): Ask questions and read destination-specific travel discussions.
- [Airline Reviews](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Airlines): Compare airlines using traveler ratings and onboard experience reviews.
- [Travel Articles](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Articles): Read destination inspiration, travel tips, and planning advice.
- [Road Trips](https://www.tripadvisor.com/RoadTrips): Explore curated road trip ideas and itineraries.
- [Tripadvisor Plus](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Plus): Learn about Tripadvisor’s membership savings and travel benefits.

## Destinations
- [United States](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Tourism-g191-Vacations.html): Explore destinations, hotels, restaurants, and attractions across the United States.
- [Europe](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Tourism-g4-Vacations.html): Discover European destinations with travel guides and booking options.
- [Asia](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Tourism-g2-Vacations.html): Plan trips across Asia using reviews, rankings, and destination pages.
- [Caribbean](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Tourism-g147237-Vacations.html): Find island destinations, resorts, beaches, and activities in the Caribbean.
- [Mexico](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Tourism-g150768-Vacations.html): Research cities, resorts, and attractions throughout Mexico.
- [South Pacific](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Tourism-g294135-Vacations.html): Browse destinations, accommodations, and activities across the South Pacific.

## Accommodation Resources
- [Best Hotels](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotels-g191-United_States-Hotels.html): Compare hotel listings, rankings, amenities, and traveler reviews.
- [B&Bs and Inns](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotels-g191-c2-United_States-Hotels.html): Find bed and breakfasts and inns in popular destinations.
- [Specialty Lodging](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotels-g191-c3-United_States-Hotels.html): Browse hostels, campgrounds, and specialty accommodations.
- [Vacation Rental Homes](https://www.tripadvisor.com/VacationRentals-g191-United_States-Vacation_Rentals.html): Search vacation rentals with photos, amenities, and availability details.
- [Hotel Deals](https://www.tripadvisor.com/SmartDeals): View hotel deals and discounted stays in major destinations.

## Dining and Experiences
- [Best Restaurants](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurants-g191-United_States.html): Search restaurants by destination, cuisine, and traveler rating.
- [Fine Dining](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurants-g191-c27-United_States.html): Browse fine dining restaurants across destinations and regions.
- [Coffee & Tea](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurants-g191-c8-United_States.html): Find cafes, coffee shops, and tea houses by location.
- [Bars & Pubs](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurants-g191-c31-United_States.html): Discover bars, pubs, and nightlife dining venues.
- [Tours](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attractions-g191-Activities-c42-United_States.html): Explore guided tours and sightseeing experiences.
- [Outdoor Activities](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attractions-g191-Activities-c61-United_States.html): Find hiking, adventure, and outdoor recreation experiences.

## Transportation
- [Flights Search](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Flights-g191-United_States-Cheap_Discount_Airfares.html): Search flights and compare airfare options for U.S. travel.
- [Airports](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Airports): Browse airport guides, reviews, and airport-related traveler information.
- [Airlines by Name](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Airlines): Review airline ratings, routes, and traveler experiences.
- [Rental Cars](https://www.tripadvisor.com/RentalCars): Compare rental car options for destinations and travel dates.
- [Cruise Lines](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Cruises): Research cruise operators, ships, and itineraries.

## Community and Reviews
- [Write a Review](https://www.tripadvisor.com/UserReviewEdit): Submit reviews for hotels, restaurants, attractions, and travel experiences.
- [Review Guidelines](https://www.tripadvisor.com/pages/review_guidelines.html): Read Tripadvisor’s standards and policies for traveler reviews.
- [Help Center](https://www.tripadvisor.com/help): Access support articles and answers to common questions.
- [Trust & Safety](https://www.tripadvisor.com/pages/trust.html): Learn about content moderation, safety, and platform integrity efforts.
- [Travelers' Choice Best of the Best](https://www.tripadvisor.com/TravelersChoice-Destinations): Explore top-ranked destinations and award categories.

## Business and Partner Resources
- [Owners](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Owners): Access tools for hospitality owners to manage Tripadvisor presence.
- [Claim Your Listing](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Owners?m=58397): Claim and manage a hotel, restaurant, or attraction listing.
- [Business Advantage](https://www.tripadvisor.com/BusinessAdvantage): Learn about subscription tools for hospitality businesses.
- [Sponsored Placements](https://www.tripadvisor.com/TripAdvisorInsights/w2550): Explore advertising and visibility options for businesses.
- [Tripadvisor Insights](https://www.tripadvisor.com/TripAdvisorInsights): Read research, benchmarks, and travel industry insights.

## Company and Policies
- [About Tripadvisor](https://www.tripadvisor.com/aboutus): Learn about Tripadvisor’s mission, brands, and company background.
- [Press Center](https://www.tripadvisor.com/PressCenter-c6-Press_Releases.html): Read company announcements and press releases.
- [Careers](https://www.tripadvisor.com/careers): Explore jobs and career opportunities at Tripadvisor.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.tripadvisor.com/pages/terms.html): Review platform terms, conditions, and legal policies.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.tripadvisor.com/pages/privacy.html): Understand Tripadvisor’s privacy practices and data handling.
- [Content Integrity Policy](https://www.tripadvisor.com/pages/content_integrity_policy.html): Review rules governing user-generated content and moderation.
